w: At 6.45 p.m. Swamishri was escorted into Mahelav with a motorcade of 25 cars, the festive sound of firecrackers, rifles and a music band. The joyful chorus of victory calls honored and heralded the arrival of Swamishri into Mahelav. Swamishri went for darshan to the small mandir on the birthplace of Shastriji Maharaj. After the darshan of Thakorji and the murti of Shastriji Maharaj, Swamishri prostrated and then left for the assembly hall. Here, Swamishri was welcomed with garlands by Pujya Mahant Swami and Pujya Tyagvallabh Swami and other dignitaries.

On addressing the assembly Swamishri said, "Mahelav is a very holy land. Shriji Maharaj, Gunatitanand Swami and Bhagatji Maharaj had visited this place so many times. Shastriji Maharaj was born in this village to accomplish the work of Lord Swaminarayan. His childhood name was Dungar and look what a great task he performed. He spread the Satsang in India and abroad and spread the divine light everywhere. He established the knowledge of Swami and Narayan, atma and Parmatma against a tornado of opposition with tremendous zeal and faith. It could not have been done under any circumstances! He had been blessed by Gunatitanand Swami. We have benefited enormously through the birth of such a great divine person. We are colored by maya and now we need to be uncolored and then re-colored with the colour of God, Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj."
Swamishri sanctified and inaugurated the new Women's Complex for the Central Satsang activities, 'Bhaktisadan', in the mandir
In the evening Swamishri left Amdavad and traveled to Mahelav.
Swamishri was accorded a warm, devotional reception in Mahelav - the birth place of Shastriji Maharaj.
Swamishri's 7-day stay here will see the inauguration of a new Swaminarayan Mandir and the celebration of Shastriji Maharaj's birthday at Mahelav.
Gems From Swamishri
To stray away from one's goal towards God is the greatest obstacle.
A man without dharma is like an animal. First he has to become an aspirant and then divine.
Only through a Gunatit sadhu can one realise the knowledge of atma and Parmatma.
One experiences inner peace by listening to God's divine sports.
ph: Pramukh Swami performing puja (morning prayers), Mahelav

w: At 4.45 pm Swamishri departed from Jamnagar and arrived in Muli and after darshan of Thakorji departed for Surendranagar, arriving at the Swaminarayan mandir at 9.00 pm.
In the morning, Swamishri performed the Shilanyas Ceremony for the new shikharbaddh mandir to be built in Akshar Vadi.
At 4.45 pm Swamishri flew from Bhavnagar to Mumbai, landing at 5.23 pm.

On the back circumambulation path at the top of the mandir, Munipremdas Swami recited a passage from "Purushottam Bolya Prite":
"In Shrinagar, Shri Hari said, 'Even a mukta of Akshardham, if he behaves with identification with the body, his liberated state turns into a bodily state.'"
Then he asked what was on everyone's mind: "We behave in a bodily state... so what?"
Mahant Swami Maharaj said, "Conviction itself is the liberated state."
Speaking a beautiful, aphoristic sentence, Swamishri reassured everyone.

ds.t: A phone on his guru's photo
w: Before his meal, Mahant Swami Maharaj's eye fell on the table. Here lay the English book "Yugvibhuti Pramukh Swami Maharaj", released today. But on its cover, on the picture of Pramukh Swami Maharaj, was a mobile phone. Without telling or signalling anyone, Swamishri himself bent down to remove it. The attendant sadhu noticed and quickly removed the phone.
Swamishri's devotion to his guru is subtle. He cannot bear even an object lying on his guru's picture.

Mahant Swami Maharaj came to the children and youth day programme. The children and youths presented a very beautiful skit on the theme of "unity". On this occasion, showering blessings, Swamishri said:

"Keep in mind that all that we have seen does not go to waste as mere play. Natak (a play) means na tak, that which does not last. Pramukh Swami Maharaj gave us just these things: to tolerate, to wear oneself out for others, to adjust, and to give up one's own will. Nothing remains outside these, but imbibing them is hard...

"Think about how we should behave from our side for unity. What if everyone behaved like this? We want to win the pleasure of Maharaj and Swami; nothing else remains. All that remains is this: unity and friendliness. Try to bring these into our lives. Whether others do it or not, do not meddle. Go by 'What is right?' To fly the flag of Akshar Purushottam, Shastriji Maharaj did just this. He went by 'What is right?' He did not resist; he tolerated. If we go by 'Who is right?', there is turmoil and fighting. Satsang is to be done according to 'What is right?'"
By giving the beautiful teaching to go by not "Who is right?" but "What is right?", Swamishri gave everyone provisions for the day.
